effect: Content uniformity failure at tablet press
cause: Poor bin design / vibration during transfer
severity_rationale: Patient safety risk without warning (e.g., content uniformity, dissolution failure reaching market).
detection_rationale: Release testing only (QC lab, post-batch).
recommendation: Redesign discharge chute to minimize free-fall/vibration and add post-discharge uniformity sampling at 3 bin locations every batch.
